facts.claim: Pine Harbor's fictional retention setting keeps detections for 730 days.
hooks: How long does Pine Harbor keep where your car was seen?

facts.claim: The fictional county produced no completed audit reports.
hooks: The policy promises audits. We asked to see them.
facts.why: A safeguard nobody can see isn't one residents can trust.
